targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, AVG(avg_kw) AS "avg kW", MAX(peak_kw) AS "peak kW" FROM tick_1m c JOIN station_map m USING (connector_ref) WHERE bucket > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND m.station_id = $station GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
SELECT bucket AS time, SUM(fault_events) AS faults, SUM(offline_events) AS offline FROM state_1m WHERE bucket > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

list.name: station
list.query: SELECT station_id FROM station_map GROUP BY 1
